pathId.description: The canonical identity of the path (e.g. "PICK", "PACK", "REBIN", "SLAM").

matchPrefix.description: Lower-case prefix downstream consumers match a caller-supplied id against: id == matchPrefix OR id starts with matchPrefix + "-". Must be non-empty and lower-case.

direct.description: A structural fact about this path's routing shape (reserved for a future multi-hop topology). Immutable once set; not revisable. A JSON null is treated the same as an omitted field (false).

requiredCapabilities.description: Capabilities a station/associate must hold to work this path.

destinationLocationRole.description: Optional declaration of what kind of facility-layout LocationRole this path's completed work is destined for (ADR 0006). Omitted entirely — or the equivalent JSON null / empty string — means no destination role was declared: the default, and most common, case (e.g. Pick has no single destination). Immutable once set at DefinePath time; never revisable via RevisePath. This is declarative routing intent this service publishes for a downstream consumer to interpret — it is never validated against a live facility-layout lookup (this service has zero inbound/outbound dependency on any other context).
destinationLocationRole.title: DestinationLocationRole

cycleTimeP95.description: The operator-declared p95 end-to-end cycle time from release into the path to manifest (ADR 0010): a declared standard, not a measured value. Required and must be positive. Encoded as a Go duration string (e.g. "2h", "90m", "2h30m").
cycleTimeP95.title: CycleTimeP95

eligibility.description: Rules a unit of work must satisfy to be routed to this path (ADR 0010). Every field is optional; an absent/empty object ({}) — or the equivalent JSON null — is the fully permissive default every path gets on migration, so today's routing behaviour is preserved exactly until an operator narrows it.

maxUnitsPerLine.description: nil/omitted means unbounded; 1 is how a singles path is declared.

requiredProductAttributes.description: Set over the fleet's existing product classification vocabulary (e.g. "hazmat", "fragile", "giftWrap"). This service does not own or validate this vocabulary.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
